title: Superb Warfare expanded
description: Modern military modpack featuring realistic guns, vehicles, helicopters, tanks, and immersive tactical combat.
body:
Superb Warfare Expanded

Turn Minecraft into a true modern battlefield.

Superb Warfare Expanded transforms Minecraft into an immersive military experience featuring realistic firearms, armored vehicles, helicopters, advanced combat mechanics, and intense battles. Whether you’re fighting alone or with friends, every encounter feels dynamic and tactical.

Features

* Modern firearms with realistic animations and attachments
* Tanks, APCs, helicopters, aircraft, and military vehicles
* Improved combat mechanics for more immersive firefights
* Carefully selected mods designed to work together
* Enhanced visuals, sound effects, and battlefield atmosphere
* Optimized for both singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay

Why choose Superb Warfare Expanded?

This isn’t just a collection of military mods.

Every mod has been selected and configured to create a balanced and enjoyable combat experience. From clearing enemy bases to driving armored convoys across the landscape, the pack is built to make every battle feel exciting.

Whether you prefer infantry combat, armored warfare, or air support, you’ll find plenty of ways to play.

Multiplayer Ready

Gather your squad and:

* Capture enemy positions
* Fight large-scale battles
* Build military bases
* Use combined arms tactics with infantry, vehicles, and aircraft

Technical Information

System Requirements:
-Allocated RAM: 6 GB (recommended)
-RAM can be reduced in the launcher settings,however
smooth gameplay is not guaranteed
- Java: 17 or higher (required for NeoForge 1.21.1)
- Number of mods: ~45

Performance Notes

- The modpack is actively in development–regular updates and improvements are being added
- On older or lower-end systems, the modpack may not run smoothly
- We recommend testing with the default RAM allocation (6 GB) and optimizing as needed

Important Notice

TACZ and several other mods cannot be installed in the NeoForge version of this modpack. These mods are built specifically for Forge and are not yet compatible with NeoForge, as their developers haven't ported them over (or the port isn't stable yet).
We know this affects some of the features/weapons you were expecting, and we're sorry for the disappointment. We're keeping an eye on updates from the mod authors and will add NeoForge support for these mods as soon as compatible versions become available.
If you specifically need TACZ and the other affected mods, we'd recommend sticking with the Forge version of the modpack for now.

Thanks for your patience and understanding!
